title: DHIS2 Observation Cards
description: Composable cards for one person's measurements over time and last recorded values, coloured by DHIS2 legend sets.
docs: Wrap the cards in ObservationsProvider with a trackedEntity and a program; the cards inside share one request for the program's metadata and one for the person's events. Render one ObservationCard per data element uid, with an optional unit, label and staleAfterDays. Without children a card picks its arrangement from the value type: numbers show the latest value, its legend, the change since the previous reading and a sparkline; other types show the last recorded value, and yes or no values and option sets say when it last changed. To compose a different card, place the parts ObservationLabel, ObservationLegend, ObservationValue, ObservationChange, ObservationSparkline and ObservationRecorded inside it. The card shows the loading, error and never recorded states itself, and the recorded date can be placed but never dropped. See the observation cards docs page for examples.
